notes.title: FQA and subsequent update plan
notes.notes: [p]Answer some of the most frequently asked questions about this game. Friends who want to see the follow-up plan can scroll directly to the end.[/p][p]FQA[/p][p]Q: Is this game pure love?[/p][p]A: Yes[/p][p]Q: Is the character that can be conquered the first love?[/p][p]A: Yes[/p][p]Q: Is there anything that cannot be described?[/p][p]A: I dare not[/p][p]Q: Why is there a censorship?[/p][p]A: Fully comply with the requirements of the s station review[/p][p]Q: Is the game a semi-finished product?[/p][p]A:: Let me first say the conclusion. From an overall perspective, yes.[/p][p]Currently, there is only the Yelong line in the game. There are also plans for the routes of the two characters Fei and Totos. These two lines are completely different from the Yelong line. The three lines together are considered a complete story.[/p][p]Q: How big is the current game volume?[/p][p]A:: More than 200,000 words of text, 50 CGs (including 18 dynamic CGs), and 15 characters with standing pictures + full voice-overs in addition to the protagonist.[/p][p]For comparison: the highly praised game "My 1/6 Lover" released by this group contains 6 characters (personalities), the total text of the public + all character lines is 210,000 words, a total of 19 CGs, and a total of 7 standing pictures.[/p][p]Q: Is your game made by AI?[/p][p]A: A total of 5 special effects/transition animations were made using AI, each about 3-5 seconds, including camera zooming out, bullets falling, screen rotation and other effects. And 4 of the 20+ background music and the theme song were generated by AI.[/p][p]Q: Why use AI?[/p][p]A: Insufficient funds. If you want to make the same effect by hand, the cost will be several times or even dozens of times higher.[/p][p]Take the theme song as an example. I asked someone to ask a metal band that can make this effect. The quote is five figures per song, which is really powerless.[/p][p]However, if too many people oppose the use of AI in the future, we will consider launching a non-AI version that deletes all the above files.[/p][p]Q: Why don't you write more about daily life?[/p][p]A: Actually, I did write some, but considering the rhythm and perception of the plot, I deleted some of the daily life and changed it to the current appearance (after all, it would be a bit strange to keep buying groceries, cooking, and eating in the crisis of city destruction).[/p][p]Similar modifications also include deleting a large number of special noun explanations, battle details, etc., all of which are trade-offs made to balance the perception as much as possible.[/p][p]Q: The script is a mess/not as good as a failed online novel[/p][p]A: We accept criticism and will work hard to write a better story. However, during the creation of our script, we also discussed and revised it with several senior copywriters and full-time online writers many times. At present, it is indeed the limit of what we can do.[/p][p][/p][p]Subsequent plans[/p][p]The Fei line and Toto line will definitely be updated. The world view, character setting, and outline of the whole story were conceived when we were still working on "Café des Evils" in 20 years. The subsequent story process and framework have also been finalized in these years, but it takes time and money to slowly produce.[/p][p]The personal lines of the two characters are expected to be 100,000-150,000 words each. In the subsequent production, the quality and quantity of CG will be prioritized, and the total number of CGs of Fei and Totos will be equal to that of Yelong. Other projects such as voice will be abandoned for the time being.[/p][p]The specific launch time cannot be guaranteed now. The Fei line should be completed by next year at the earliest, and it will be released in the form of 6 yuan DLC at that time.[/p][p]PS1: No matter which route, all the playable characters will not have ambiguous plots with characters other than the protagonist[/p][p]PS2: Some friends may have noticed our recently released store page "Your Niu Zi", which is a single-character super short funny pure love work. In addition to the production of "Remnant God Awakening", we should also launch some similar short stories.[/p]

notes.title: 这大概就是最后了
notes.notes:
大家好，这里是lamb of game

今天是《残神觉醒》上架的第四天，截止目前为止，本作的评论数为四，总销量尚未超过一百份
一次史无前例的巨大失败

正如幻想过游戏爆火的可能性一样，对于失败的可能性自然也有着预期
只不过确实没想到会失败到这种程度

正如之前的公告所说，相比以前的游戏来，本作在上线前的愿望单是最多的一次，因此知道点击上线按钮的那一刻也依旧是信心满满
如果一个月内能回本的话，就可以把剩下的两条剧情线路做完
保守一点，如果能回本50%的话，稍微控制一下成本应该也可以
最差的情况只回本20%、30%的话，大概就要想办法压缩一下剧情或者暂时只做一条线吧

可惜现实比幻想总归还要更绝望一些

是选题不好吗、是角色不够出彩吗、是定价太高吗、是故事不够有趣吗……
能想到的可能性有很多，只是终究也没有头绪，不过我想那些大概也已经不重要了吧
正如自己在剧本中写下的反派所说的话语那般
“败了，那就是败了。”

本作从21年就开始着手制作，四年多的时间，投入超过二十余万，不管是时间还是成本都已经比过去所有作品加起来还要多
诚然，这点投入在游戏行业算不上什么，不过也确实是花光了这些年来所有的积蓄
只是就算这样也依旧有些捉襟见肘，最终也只能保证夜珑单角色的剧情线，将预期中的菲和托托丝的路线暂时砍掉

不过还请放心，尽管预期中三条线分别对应1-3周目，但夜珑线的剧情也依旧是完整且独立的一部分

至于后续两条线路的话，目前属实是有心无力
这个故事确实是投入了几乎所有的心血，世界观、人设、大纲……
每个角色、每个细节都是反反复复修改完善了十数次的结果，想要写出的是“心目中的王道热血故事”，若是可能的话，我也想将他写完

后续的事暂时还没想好，或许会用现有素材尝试制作，或许再攒下一些钱之后再作打算，容我再考虑一段时间吧

失业两年有余，如今存款耗尽，也是时候该将重心放回找工作去了
至于以后还会不会有新的作品，现在也没法给出一个准确的答案，毕竟未来还很长，谁也不知道会发生什么
说了太多感觉又有些像是在卖惨，还是就在这打住吧


衷心感谢各位一路陪伴过来的玩家们，谢谢你们的认可与喜欢


抱歉，终究没能写完这个故事
